subtopics.title: Symmetric Key Cryptography Basics
subtopics.summary: The shared-secret-key model in which sender and receiver use the same key; classical ciphers such as the Caesar cipher; cryptanalysis approaches including brute-force and known-plaintext attacks.

subtopics.title: Block Ciphers and Stream Ciphers
subtopics.summary: Modern symmetric techniques: block ciphers that encrypt fixed-size blocks (illustrated with a 3-bit example cipher, DES, and AES) and stream ciphers that encrypt bit by bit.

subtopics.title: Cipher Block Chaining (CBC)
subtopics.summary: Chaining ciphertext blocks together with an initialization vector (IV) so that identical plaintext blocks produce different ciphertext, avoiding the pattern leaks of encrypting blocks independently.

subtopics.title: Public Key Cryptography Concepts
subtopics.summary: The two-key model with a publicly available key and a private key; how anyone can encrypt a message to a recipient while only the private-key holder can decrypt, and why a shared secret key implicitly identifies the sender while public key encryption does not.

subtopics.title: RSA Algorithm
subtopics.summary: RSA key generation from primes p and q (computing n, z, choosing e and d), encryption and decryption via modular exponentiation, and why the algorithm works, with worked examples such as encrypting a word letter by letter.
